scope: Measurement correctness (token floor, categories) plus the harshest public corpus set. No model was run.

stage_1_token_floor.why: Without a minimum-token floor a refusal count is inflated by construction. A competing tool measured the same model at 30 tokens -> ~8/100 refusals, 50 -> ~18, 100 -> ~60, 150 -> ~60 (converged).

implementation.gguf: llama-server exposes no positional min_new_tokens, so the stop token is suppressed (ignore_eos) and the floor becomes that request's cap
implementation.cached: floor_enforced rides in the saved answer so a cached result cannot be re-read as truncation
implementation.degenerate: forced continuation past a natural stop yields filler; a degenerate-output filter classifies repetition and stop-token spam as refusal evidence without a judge call

stage_1_token_floor.bug_found_by_test: bool("yes") silently coerced a bogus floor flag to True; now rejected

stage_2_categories.summarize: by_category with an explicit uncategorised bucket, plus degenerate_total
stage_2_categories.new_signal: category_stalled reports categories where refusals did not move at all, which is where harm survives in untouched experts
stage_2_categories.note: per-task refusal regression already failed trials, so the category layer adds the stalled signal and reporting rather than new strictness

stage_3_harsh_corpora.over_refusal_control: WildJailbreak adversarial_benign (210 adversarial-form but benign prompts) plus alpaca

importer_features_added: category from a column or literal
prompt template over several columns (HarmBench ContextString + Behavior)
list_column unwrapping (Sorry-Bench turns is a list literal)
where row filter (splits one file into harmful and benign sources)
honest_limits: No model has been run against these suites. Nothing here is refusal-quality evidence.
Directions remain authored en/nl; MultiJail (10 languages) is imported-ready but matched multilingual harmless controls are still missing.

Synthetic row-group families remain for corpora with no category column (WildJailbreak, AdvBench, MaliciousInstruct); they are fine for per-language-mean methods and meaningless for per-family rank methods.
The judge swap is still pending: a small recent instruct model is needed, and Qwen3Guard/ZTC-Judge are the wrong shape (they label safety/trust, not compliance).
Method gaps remain untouched: discriminative layer selection, q/k/v as edit targets, wider strength ranges, expert-granular MoE projection.
